# Chris Demetriou – Software Developer & Consultant, Manchester

> Chris Demetriou is an independent software developer and consultant based in Manchester, UK. He turns business problems into custom tools and applications, from the first idea to a tested, working solution: understanding the problem, designing the solution, building, testing and launching it. Clients own the code and the hosting accounts outright: no seat licences, no licence fees ("Zero Software Tax").

## Internal Tool Blueprints

- Booking Engine: clients choose an available slot, the organisation approves it from its inbox, and calendar invites are issued automatically.
- Reminder Pipeline: scheduled email, push and WhatsApp alerts.
- Chasing Engine: finds who hasn't replied, nudges only them, and confirms once everyone is in.
- Payment Pipeline: invoices, card payments through Stripe, and each payment verified before the record is marked paid.
- Client Portal: secure passkey sign-in for clients, members or volunteers.
- Self-Checking Records: directories and records that re-check themselves on a schedule and flag anything out of date.

## How it works

- Understand the problem: a free written audit by email, with a one-page map of what a tool could fix. No calls or meetings.
- Design the solution: a written design and scope with a fixed price, agreed before any work starts.
- Build and test, then launch.
- Handover: code in the client's GitHub, the tool in the client's Cloudflare account, plain-English notes. Optional monthly support plan.
- Running costs are billed to the client's own accounts at cost, typically from about £4 a month.

## Proof (live tools)

- [Neuro Support Checker](https://neurosupport.labs.chrisdemetriou.com/): a free UK directory of 900 support groups for autism, ADHD, dyslexia and more, re-checked every morning.
- [Genesis](https://genesis.labs.chrisdemetriou.com/): a scheduling and chasing engine running a working band's diary.
- [CDCS Contracts](https://cdcscontracts.com/): a demo booking-to-payment pipeline for a trade business (Stripe test mode).
- [Reach Children Uganda](https://reach-children-uganda.org.uk/): legacy system recovery for a UK children's charity; 154 pages recovered from web archives and rebuilt off WordPress.
- [Labs](https://labs.chrisdemetriou.com/): build notes for every project.

## Background

- Sixteen years on enterprise systems used by thousands of companies worldwide.
- Twenty years in professional studios: performer on an Oscar-nominated song (Accidentally In Love, Shrek 2), orchestral arranger on a GRAMMY-nominated single (Seal, Walk On By), assistant engineer on Hans Zimmer's King Arthur soundtrack. Full credits: https://chrisdemetriou.com/creative/
